lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A primary grid of high-intensity, circular pixel clusters is visible along the mid-lateral flank, arranged in a repetitive rectangular lattice with local maxima concentrated posterior to the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: High-luminance nodes are positioned at the intersections of vertical bands of elevated intensity and horizontal linear ridges, creating a distinct checkerboard structural pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features extend longitudinally across the flank, characterized by a high-contrast luminance gradient with a light superior edge and a distinct shadowed inferior boundary.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of small, high-luminance circular blobs is visible within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, primarily localized toward the posterior and basal regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple reddish-brown irregular patches are visible along the mid-flank and near the dorsal fin insertion point, consistent with localized skin abrasions or parasitic lesions.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-frequency distribution of small, high-luminance spots along its leading edge, transitioning to larger, more widely spaced blobs toward the trailing edge.
